name: How long does it take to install a new stair handrail?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new stair handrail?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stair handrail installation depends on the project's scope and complexity. A straightforward replacement of an existing handrail on a standard staircase might take 1-2 days. More elaborate projects involving custom fabrication, multiple turns, or complex baluster systems could extend to several days or even a week. We aim to complete projects efficiently while maintaining high quality, and we'll provide a timeline estimate during your initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for a stair handrail varies, from 1-2 days for simple replacements to several days for complex custom projects.
